# Reprobuild

> Reprobuild (`repro`, v0.2.25, Apache-2.0) combines BuildXL's monitored automatic dependency tracking, Nix's pinned toolchains in a content-addressed store with atomic generations, and Terraform's plan-and-apply state reconciliation into one compile-time-checked Nim DSL (`repro.nim`, `home.nim`, `system.nim`) across Linux, macOS and Windows. Every link below resolves to a standalone Markdown (`.md`) topic file so an agent can load only the topic its current task requires.

Reprobuild models the workspace as a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of type-checked actions defined in the **`repro.nim`** DSL. Sibling repositories declared as **`repos/*.toml`** fragments in the workspace root (whose policy lives in **`repro-workspace.toml`**) are routed dynamically using **`repro develop`** (develop-mode). Build hermeticity is enforced using the **`librepro_monitor_shim`** user-space filesystem interceptor, and execution is cached locally through a per-edge disk store fronted by a host-wide **shared-memory grow-only index** that every engine inserts into directly. Package toolchains are concretized using a **`clingo`** solver, and background services are orchestrated using **`servicePlaceholder`** declarations.

**Non-interactive CLI rules for agents:**

When invoking `repro` from an automated tool call (with no interactive TTY):

- **Run commands inside the project environment with `repro exec -- <cmd> [args...]`** — never invoke `repro shell`, which opens an interactive subshell and blocks non-TTY callers.
- **Request structured output with `--json`** (or `--format=json` on `capabilities`): `repro version --json`, `repro health --json [--offline]`, `repro graph --json`, `repro why <target> --json`, `repro show-conventions --json`, `repro stats overview --json`, `repro pressure --json`.
- **Preview host or account changes before applying**: run `repro infra plan` before `repro infra apply --plan <id>`, and `repro home plan` before `repro home apply`.
- **Never hand-edit generated lock or scan files**: update `repro.lock` with `repro lock update [<dep>]` or `repro lock refresh`, and update `repro.scanned-deps.nim` with `repro deps refresh`.

## Agent Topic Guides

- [Reprobuild Intro for Agents (Start Here)](https://docs.reprobuild.com/agents/intro.md): Core architecture keywords, non-interactive CLI rules (`repro exec`, `--json`), binary pair (`repro` + `reprobuild`), and lock-pin refusal guardrails. (local checkout: `docs/agents/Repro-Intro-for-Agents.md`)
- [Idiomatic Reprobuild (Before Editing `repro.nim`)](https://docs.reprobuild.com/agents/idiomatic-reprobuild.md): Action granularity, narrow declared inputs vs `io-mon` observation, collections, non-determinism, and common agent anti-patterns. (local checkout: `docs/user-guide/idiomatic-reprobuild.md`)
- [Test History, Timings, and RunQuota Store](https://docs.reprobuild.com/agents/test-history-and-timings.md): Querying test durations, peak RSS, and exit signals from the host-wide RunQuota observation store. (local checkout: `docs/agents/Test-History-And-Timings.md`)
- [Profiling Reprobuild Workloads](https://docs.reprobuild.com/agents/profiling-for-optimization.md): Measuring scheduler, cache, and build-action bottlenecks accurately before optimizing. (local checkout: `docs/agents/Profiling-For-Optimization.md`)
- [How Reprobuild Replaces Bazel, Buck2, BuildXL, and Tup](https://docs.reprobuild.com/agents/replaces/build-systems.md): Type-checked DAG actions, `librepro_monitor_shim` hermeticity, and shared-memory action cache index. (local checkout: `docs/agents/Replaces/How-Repro-Replaces-Build-Systems-Like-Bazel-Buck2-BuildXL-and-Tup.md`)
- [How Reprobuild Replaces Nix, direnv, devenv, Spack, Conan, and Process Compose](https://docs.reprobuild.com/agents/replaces/environments-and-services.md): Clingo-solved package constraints, locked dev-env overlays, and `servicePlaceholder` daemon orchestration. (local checkout: `docs/agents/Replaces/How-Repro-Replaces-Environment-and-Service-Managers-Like-Nix-Direnv-Devenv-and-Process-Compose.md`)
- [How Reprobuild Replaces direnv (`repro allow` Trust Model)](https://docs.reprobuild.com/agents/replaces/direnv.md): Zero-bypass environment activation, closure-hash `repro allow` verification, and CI `REPRO_DEV_ENV_AUTO_ALLOW=1`. (local checkout: `docs/agents/Replaces/How-Repro-Replaces-Direnv.md`)
- [How Reprobuild Replaces Just and Make](https://docs.reprobuild.com/agents/replaces/task-runners.md): Declaring and invoking named automation tasks (`repro tasks`, `repro run`) inside the locked dev environment. (local checkout: `docs/agents/Replaces/How-Repro-Replaces-Task-Runners-Like-Just-and-Make.md`)
- [How Reprobuild Replaces repo and Git Submodules](https://docs.reprobuild.com/agents/replaces/workspace-managers.md): Multi-repository manifests (`repro-workspace.toml`, `repos/*.toml`), branch roles, and `repro develop` routing. (local checkout: `docs/agents/Replaces/How-Repro-Replaces-Workspace-Managers-Like-Repo-and-Git-Submodules.md`)
- [How Reprobuild Replaces Local Terraform and Dotfile Managers](https://docs.reprobuild.com/agents/replaces/infrastructure-provisioners.md): Declarative `home.nim` and `system.nim` state resources, `plan`/`apply`, and atomic generation rollbacks. (local checkout: `docs/agents/Replaces/How-Repro-Replaces-Local-Infrastructure-Provisioners-Like-Terraform.md`)

## Getting Started

- [Reprobuild documentation](https://docs.reprobuild.com/index.md): Reprobuild combines BuildXL's monitored dependency tracking, Nix's pinned store and generations, and Terraform's plan-and-apply state reconciliation into one compile-time-checked build and system graph. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/index.md`)
- [Install reprobuild](https://docs.reprobuild.com/install.md): Install repro on Linux, macOS or Windows through your package manager, Nix, Scoop or a release archive, and check that it runs. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/install.md`)
- [Build your first project](https://docs.reprobuild.com/tutorials/first-build.md): Build a project with a library and a program, change the library, and add a package that reprobuild finds from your imports. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/tutorials/first-build.md`)

## Concepts and Architecture

- [How reprobuild works](https://docs.reprobuild.com/concepts/how-reprobuild-works.md): How Reprobuild combines BuildXL's monitored dependency graph, Nix's content-addressed store and generations, and Terraform's plan-and-apply reconciliation from one project file up to ReproOS and fleets. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/concepts/how-reprobuild-works.md`)
- [Conventions and the three modes](https://docs.reprobuild.com/concepts/conventions-and-modes.md): Why most projects need little or no project file, how reprobuild chooses between a project's layout, its ecosystem manifest and its project file, and when to move from one mode to another. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/concepts/conventions-and-modes.md`)
- [Dependencies and the store](https://docs.reprobuild.com/concepts/dependencies-and-the-store.md): How a project names the tools and libraries it depends on, how reprobuild chooses one version of each, and where it keeps what it obtains. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/concepts/dependencies-and-the-store.md`)
- [How caching stays correct](https://docs.reprobuild.com/concepts/how-caching-stays-correct.md): What reprobuild checks before it reuses an action's result, why an input nobody declared still counts, and what happens when that check cannot be made. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/concepts/how-caching-stays-correct.md`)
- [Tests and certificates](https://docs.reprobuild.com/concepts/tests-and-certificates.md): How reprobuild runs tests as part of the build graph, splits a suite across machines, and records which content passed which tests. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/concepts/tests-and-certificates.md`)
- [Resources and state](https://docs.reprobuild.com/concepts/resources-and-state.md): How a project declares resources of types any repository can define, as Terraform uses providers, and how reprobuild reconciles them, records their state and leases them to the tests that use them. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/concepts/resources-and-state.md`)
- [Machines and profiles](https://docs.reprobuild.com/concepts/machines-and-profiles.md): How a profile describes your account or a whole operating system, how repro infra plans and applies it as Terraform does, and how each change becomes a generation you can roll back. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/concepts/machines-and-profiles.md`)
- [Fleets and the deploy agent](https://docs.reprobuild.com/concepts/fleets-and-the-deploy-agent.md): How every machine in a fleet keeps the state you declare for it, by fetching a signed manifest and applying it with the same steps as repro infra apply. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/concepts/fleets-and-the-deploy-agent.md`)

## How-To Guides

- [Build an existing project](https://docs.reprobuild.com/guides/building/build-an-existing-project.md): Build a Cargo, Go or CMake project with reprobuild by adding a short project file next to its existing manifest. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/guides/building/build-an-existing-project.md`)
- [Enter a project's environment](https://docs.reprobuild.com/guides/environments/enter-a-project-environment.md): Start a shell with a project's tools and variables, run one command inside its environment, choose an activity, or print the environment for another tool. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/guides/environments/enter-a-project-environment.md`)
- [Diagnose your setup with repro health](https://docs.reprobuild.com/guides/troubleshooting/diagnose-with-repro-health.md): Run reprobuild's environment check, read each failure and its remedy, apply the safe fixes automatically, and use the check in CI. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/guides/troubleshooting/diagnose-with-repro-health.md`)
- [Join a workspace](https://docs.reprobuild.com/guides/workspaces/join-a-workspace.md): Clone a multi-repository workspace onto a new machine, choose which of its projects to check out, and keep every repository current. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/guides/workspaces/join-a-workspace.md`)
- [Build a repository from its layout](https://docs.reprobuild.com/guides/building/build-a-monorepo-from-its-layout.md): Build a repository arranged as apps/<name>/ and libs/<name>/ with no project file, and check what reprobuild inferred from it. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/guides/building/build-a-monorepo-from-its-layout.md`)
- [Activate environments when you change directory](https://docs.reprobuild.com/guides/environments/activate-on-directory-change.md): Install reprobuild's shell hook so a project's environment switches on when you enter its directory and off when you leave, and grant or withdraw trust per directory. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/guides/environments/activate-on-directory-change.md`)
- [Work on a dependency's source](https://docs.reprobuild.com/guides/workspaces/develop-a-dependency.md): Check out one of your repository's dependencies next to it, build your repository against your changes to it, and return to the locked revision when you are done. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/guides/workspaces/develop-a-dependency.md`)
- [Keep an existing Nix flake as the environment](https://docs.reprobuild.com/guides/environments/keep-a-nix-flake-environment.md): Activate a repository's existing flake dev shell through reprobuild, without changing the flake and without direnv. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/guides/environments/keep-a-nix-flake-environment.md`)

## Coming From Other Tools

- [Coming from Nix](https://docs.reprobuild.com/coming-from/nix.md): How flakes, derivations, dev shells, the store and generations map onto reprobuild, what works differently, and when Nix is the better choice. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/coming-from/nix.md`)
- [Coming from Bazel and Buck2](https://docs.reprobuild.com/coming-from/bazel-and-buck2.md): How BUILD files, targets, rules, actions and caches map onto reprobuild, what works differently, and when Bazel or Buck2 is the better choice. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/coming-from/bazel-and-buck2.md`)
- [Coming from direnv, devenv and mise](https://docs.reprobuild.com/coming-from/direnv-devenv-and-mise.md): How per-directory environments, tool versions, tasks and processes from direnv, devenv and mise map onto reprobuild, and when those tools are the better choice. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/coming-from/direnv-devenv-and-mise.md`)
- [Coming from just and make](https://docs.reprobuild.com/coming-from/just-and-make-tasks.md): How just recipes and make targets used as a task runner map onto reprobuild's tasks and build actions, and when just or make is the better choice. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/coming-from/just-and-make-tasks.md`)
- [Coming from repo and git submodules](https://docs.reprobuild.com/coming-from/repo-and-git-submodules.md): How Google's repo manifests and git submodules map onto reprobuild workspaces, what works differently, and when repo or submodules are the better choice. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/coming-from/repo-and-git-submodules.md`)
- [Coming from Terraform and OpenTofu](https://docs.reprobuild.com/coming-from/terraform-and-opentofu.md): How Terraform's plan-and-apply model carries over to reprobuild's operating-system profiles and fleets, what works differently, and why Terraform or OpenTofu remains the tool for cloud resources. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/coming-from/terraform-and-opentofu.md`)

## Reference

- [Commands](https://docs.reprobuild.com/reference/commands.md): Every user-facing repro command and subcommand, generated from the CLI description and grouped both by domain and alphabetically. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/reference/commands/index.md`)
- [Command equivalents](https://docs.reprobuild.com/reference/command-equivalents.md): The reprobuild command closest to each command of Nix, Home Manager, Bazel, Buck2, direnv, mise, just, Docker Compose, process-compose, repo and Terraform. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/reference/command-equivalents.md`)
- [Glossary](https://docs.reprobuild.com/reference/glossary.md): The one name reprobuild's documentation uses for each concept, with the synonyms it avoids. (local checkout: `docs/users/content/reference/glossary.md`)
